lore_anchors.definition: A major cultivation stage where a cultivator condenses their power into a solid core, vastly increasing lifespan and combat ability. They are the highest authority figures in the Yue Kingdom's cultivation world.

The stage where a cultivator creates a solid foundation of power. Those at this stage are considered true cultivators, possessing significantly more power and longevity than Qi Condensation disciples.
A one-time-use talisman that seals a fraction of a powerful magical treasure's might. It allows weaker cultivators to wield immense, albeit limited, power. They are highly coveted.

The rarest and most powerful type of spiritual root, belonging to a single element. Cultivators with a Heavenly Spiritual Root face almost no bottlenecks in cultivation and advance at a terrifying pace, marking them as destined geniuses.

A life-threatening internal disorder where a cultivator's own energy spirals out of control, often caused by emotional disturbance, spiritual backlash, or cultivation errors. It can lead to severe injury or death.
